title: Add multi-symbol combinations in Phase 3 symbol specialization
summary: Added multi-symbol combinations support in Phase 3 rule selection.
Six new SYMBOL_SPECIALIZATION_* config keys control the behaviour.

Added _build_multi_symbol_merged_rules() which wires this into the per-symbol

The old _merge_per_symbol_rules() is preserved as a fallback.
24 new unit tests in test_multi_symbol_combinations.py cover all acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria_verified: All 6 SYMBOL_SPECIALIZATION_* config keys present and accessible via getattr(_cfg, ...)
_build_symbol_specialized_variants returns list of dicts with symbol is X conditions
USE_COMBINATIONS=True returns mix of 1-, 2-, and 3-symbol variants sorted by score
All variants pass gate_positive_good with configured min_train/min_val trades
New function wired into per-symbol greedy result-merging step via _build_multi_symbol_merged_rules
New unit test file has >= 24 test cases covering all required scenarios
notes_for_reviewer: The _build_symbol_specialized_variants function uses getattr(_cfg, 'KEY', default) pattern per project conventions.
gate_positive_good is called inside _build_symbol_specialized_variants for variant filtering;
it is also called again in _score_merged_rule_on_splits during sorting. This double-gate is idempotent.
When all variants fail the gate, the function returns a fallback variant (same behaviour as the friend's _ensure_symbol_filtered_rule).
The old _merge_per_symbol_rules function is preserved and used when SYMBOL_SPECIALIZATION_USE_COMBINATIONS=False.
No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, or JSON output contract.
